contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ P SEPT GETA CAES PONT ; R/ PRINC IVV ENTVT IS

Silver coin. Denarius of Geta (209-212), probably mint of Rome RIC vol. 4 part 1 page 316 no. 18, issue of 200-202 as Caesar. Obverse description: Youthful bust bare headed draped ?and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: P SEPT GETA CAES PONT. Reverse description: Soldier with cloak and vertical sceptre with right arm extended, trophy of arms to right. Reverse inscription: PRINC IVV ENTVT IS. Diameter: 16.7mm, Weight: 1.68gms, die axis: 6
